events.text: The K2 identity change does not settle my independent refresh-race concern. No concurrent refresh test has run. Keep this concern open and test overlapping refreshes before claiming it resolved.
At revision K2 the fix changes ReportCacheKey to (organization_id, user_id, locale). The reproduced cross-organization download now returns distinct bytes. Locale must remain in the key.

Atlas report-download cache leakage reproduction: the same account in organizations Redwood and Birch received identical cached bytes despite distinct report bodies. The second request reused the first entry.
